questions.q: What is the formula for average speed?
questions.why: The script states average speed equals total distance divided by total time.

questions.q: A cyclist rides 120 m in 30 s. What is the average speed?
questions.why: 120 m divided by 30 s gives 4 m/s.

questions.q: A runner covers 200 m in 50 s. What is the average speed?
questions.why: 200 m divided by 50 s gives 4 m/s.
